text_block_list.text:
When I visited the Student Council room to 
deliver the documents requested by Symboli 
Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh, hey Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Teio's... If you have business with 
the President, she should be back shortly.
choice_data_list: I'll take you up on that and wait, then.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then come watch our chess match! I'm about 
to beat Air Groove any second now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what nonsense. You haven't won 
against me even once, have you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: B-But today, I'm gonna wiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I win, the Prez said she'd 'run 
together with me'!!
choice_data_list: It's hit or miss—give it all you've got!
Go for broke, even if you crash and burn!

Let's plan out our strategy and give it 
our all!

Let's plan out our strategy and do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I win, the Prez said she'd 'run 
together with me'!!
choice_data_list: It's hit or miss—give it all you've got!
Go for broke, even if you crash and burn!

Let's plan out our strategy and give it 
our all!

Let's plan out our strategy and do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why's that!? If you're gonna say anything, 
just tell me 'You'll definitely win'~!
choice_data_list: The competition was just too tough.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I never thought you could be so 
cold-hearted, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez!! If that's how it's gonna be, I'm 
gonna win no matter what it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Now that bothersome Queen 
is out of the way too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Did you both see that?! My victory is 
already set in stone~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Teio, I, too, recognize your brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, getting careless and letting your 
focus drift the moment you think you have 
the upper hand is a bad habit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Let the comeback begin. Bishop to this 
square.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ack?! No way, no way!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your quick understanding. At 
this rate, it'll be checkmate on the next 
move, but do you have a plan?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: U-Urrrgh~. …………I surrender.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A Queen's Sacrifice, is it? Magnificently 
done, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, Teio. It seems your battle lines 
collapsed right at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Collapse... Teio...? ...Hokai... Hokai...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Replacing Tokai with Houkai 
(collapse)... heh heh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez, Pres! Laughing at me is so mean~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: F-Forgive me. But you see, your Trainer...

Symboli Rudolf's laughter didn't subside 
for quite a while, and a sulking Tokai 
Teio stomped off with raised shoulders to 
do her running drills.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh, leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to chess, I've been playing 
ever since I was little!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Neither Papa nor Mama was any match for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then prove to me that this victory wasn't 
pampered or handed to you on a silver 
platter."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Go on, defeat the "Empress" right before 
your Trainer's eyes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuuuu~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Air Groove. She's not 
going to let me win so easily, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to wave the white flag, be my 
guest. The President should be returning 
soon anyway, making this a good stopping 
point.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No no no! I'm never giving up!
choice_data_list:
Let's stay calm, especially at times like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...! You're right. Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Calm down! Remember Air Groove's 
personality and the tactics she's used up 
until now!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Whether I play purely on defense or go on 
the attack, I get snared either way. 
That's because I can't break out of the 
challenger's mindset.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(...I will surpass the 'Empress.' I'm 
going to set a trap for Air Groove!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: W-We did it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think that I would be defeated. It's 
your victory, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It seems you have found a fine mentor. 
Continue to devote yourself to your craft.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a shame. I wanted to witness the 
match between those two with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! Listen, listen! I beat Air Groove!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, is that so...? Then I must keep my 
promise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My schedule for tomorrow just opened up. 
Care to run together, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Running, running~! Ehehe, I love you, 
Prez!!"

Competing against Air Groove gave Tokai 
Teio confidence, and reminded her of the 
importance of crafting a solid strategy.
